record.question: Least count of prismatic compass is -
record.explanation: The standard prismatic-compass ring is graduated to half a degree: 0.5°=30 arcminutes=1800 arcseconds. None of 30,45,60 seconds matches, so “None of the above” is correct. Reference: https://bharatskills.gov.in/pdf/E_Books/Surveyor1stsemTT.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
